term: guarded forall of box to box of guarded forall
definition: For every arbitrary total P and evaluation world w, if each candidate existing at w satisfies P at every accessible v, then every candidate existing at each such v satisfies P v. Empty existence extensions are allowed.
note: Approved source-free semantic interface for fixed-roster actualist domain transfer. No physical or metaphysical domain policy is asserted. No free-logic proof calculus, counterpart semantics, or general quantified syntax is introduced.
